sources.title: Water resources planning guideline
sources.verified_claim: The June 2026 guideline sets the process for secure sustainable water-resource planning, demand and supply forecasting, uncertainty and future WRMP cycles. It is a planning framework and not evidence of available capacity at a sample parcel.

sources.title: Water supply, wastewater and water quality
sources.verified_claim: Planning guidance requires authorities and water companies to consider water supply, wastewater infrastructure and receiving-environment capacity for growth. Strategic consideration does not establish exact parcel network headroom.

sources.title: Water cycle studies
sources.verified_claim: Environment Agency guidance explains that water-cycle studies support plan-making by assessing water supply, wastewater, flood and environmental infrastructure implications of growth. A study method is not a parcel result without the relevant local assessment.

sources.title: Drainage and wastewater management plans: guiding principles for the water industry
sources.verified_claim: The guidance requires long-term DWMPs to address current and future capacity, population growth, climate change and resilience. Plan-level risk management does not prove sewer or treatment headroom at a sample parcel.

sources.title: Water resources
sources.verified_claim: Thames Water's government-approved WRMP24 identifies a significant future supply-demand shortfall and sets long-term leakage, demand-management and new-resource actions through 2075. Regional shortfall and planned investment are not exact parcel connection capacity.

sources.title: Drainage and Wastewater Management Plan 2028 (DWMP28)
sources.verified_claim: DWMP28 is being developed as a 25-year statutory plan covering population change, climate change, asset health and resilience, with consultation and final publication later in the cycle. Work-in-progress planning is not a parcel sewer-capacity confirmation.

sources.title: Drainage strategies
sources.verified_claim: Thames Water describes network pressure from rainfall, population growth and urbanisation and a multi-year programme to reduce flooding and pollution risk. Regional programme activity does not establish the sample parcels' sewer headroom.

sources.title: Final determinations in the 2024 price review
sources.verified_claim: Ofwat's PR24 final-determination hub includes the Thames Water price-control determination for the 2025-30 period. Allowed expenditure and outcome commitments are company-level regulatory evidence, not a parcel-specific capacity reservation.
